entries.name: MALT
entries.role: Metagenomic alignment, taxonomic classification and reference-index building
entries.coverage_note: The source-tested original 0.4.1 BlastN controller and native geometry/naive-assignment components are development subsets. P002 separately reports a custom 0.5.2 database build/screen with maximum-alignments-per-reference 100000 and aligned-read output. Version-specific0.5.2 integration and the complete historical reference/data requirements remain open. Original0.4.1 Local clip defects and incomplete query consumption are refused. Read MALT_ALIGNMENT.md and MALT_HOPS_PAPER_ROLES.md. No whole-tool or biological credit.

entries.name: HOPS
entries.role: Ancient-pathogen candidate assessment from metagenomic alignment evidence
entries.coverage_note: Native source-bound evidence statistics and original R contracts are development components. Full HOPS execution, species extraction, damage profiles and paper-specific candidate authentication remain open. Insufficient-read candidates remain unassessable. Read HOPS_EVIDENCE.md and MALT_HOPS_PAPER_ROLES.md; no full-pipeline or biological admission.

entries.name: MaltExtract
entries.role: Target-species RMA extraction and alignment/damage-related summaries
entries.coverage_note: P002 supplement section 3.3 names MaltExtract but does not state its version/settings. Qualify a permitted original provider, reference taxonomy/resources and the declared extraction/filter choices. Manual candidate assessment and the separate 7508-genome bacterial rescreen remain distinct. The old standalone repository README explicitly refers users to HOPS for current instructions. Read MALT_HOPS_PAPER_ROLES.md; no extraction or biological result is admitted.

exclusions: Exact uppercase software tokens distinguish the two checked non-software occurrences; case-insensitive literal census is retained separately in malt-hops-paper-roles.
